title: deploy response
description: Standard output of deploy in JSON mode (DEPLOY-031, DEPLOY-032; noos DEPLOY-520). $defs/base is DeployResponse (overview 2.1).

oneOf.description: AA_DEPLOY failed: 'Deploy failed: AA_DEPLOY exited with status <n>' (or 'did not run: <why>'), then a newline and its standard error when it wrote any (DEPLOY-031).
A problem of the workspace: aa_deploy.sh missing or not executable while AA_DEPLOY is its default (COM-150), a secret not in the environment of a run that can't ask (DEPLOY-042).

anyOf.description: Where the backend is noos: the project was flashed (DEPLOY-520).
